title: WAKE UP AND SAY THIS IMMEDIATELY — WHAT GOD DOES NEXT WILL LEAVE YOU SPEECHLESS
text: Hallelujah. Hallelujah. Hallelujah. Oh, we worship you, Lord. We worship you tonight. We worship you, ancient of days. You are the one who sits above the circle of the earth. You are the one whose train fills the temple. And right now, in this moment, we are not just having a broadcast, we are not just having a program. Heaven is colliding with earth. The throne room is bending low. And I need you, wherever you are, whether you are watching this at 2:00 a.m., whether you are watching this on your bed, whether you are in your car, whether you are in a hospital room, I need you to understand that this is not a coincidence. The God of heaven arranged this moment. He arranged for you to be here. He arranged for this word to find you. And I'm telling you, by the authority of the spirit of the living God, what God is about to do in your life will leave men speechless. But before we go any further, I want you to do something for me. I want you to share this message right now. Don't wait. Don't say, "I will do it later." Right now, take this video, send it to someone. Send it to your family WhatsApp group. Send it to that friend who has been going through a difficult season. Send it to that brother, that sister, that mother, that father, because you may be the instrument God uses tonight to rewrite somebody's story. You may not know it, but there is someone who is about to give up, and this is the word that will pull them back from the edge. So, share it. Share it now. And then come back, because what God is about to release in this atmosphere will not leave you the same. Father, we thank you. We thank you for this gathering. We thank you that you are not a God who is far off. You are a God who is near. And right now, let your presence saturate this place. Let your presence saturate every room, every house, every hospital bed, every prison cell, every place where your children are connected to this word, in the name of Jesus, in the mighty name of Jesus. Now, lift your hands wherever you are. I want to read you something and I need you to hear this not with your physical ears but with the ears of your spirit. Because what I am about to share with you is not information, it is revelation. And revelation does what information cannot do. Information fills the mind, revelation transforms the life. Open your Bible with me to the book of Isaiah chapter 60 verses 1 through 3. And it says, "Arise, shine, for thy light is come, and the glory of the Lord is risen upon thee. For behold, the darkness shall cover the earth, and gross darkness the people. But the Lord shall arise upon thee, and his glory shall be seen upon thee. And the Gentiles shall come to thy light, and kings to the brightness of thy rising." Did you hear that? "Arise, shine, for thy light is come." Now, I want you to understand this. The prophet Isaiah is not making a suggestion. This is not a polite request. This is a command from the courts of heaven. God is saying, "Wake up, get up, rise, because something has happened in the realm of the spirit that demands a response from you in the realm of the earth." You see, many believers are asleep and I'm not talking about physical sleep alone. I am talking about spiritual slumber. There is a sleep that comes upon the spirit of a man where his eyes are open but his discernment is shut down. Where he is breathing but he's not living. Where he is existing but he's not advancing. And the enemy loves it when you are in that condition because a sleeping soldier cannot fight. A sleeping watchman cannot see the enemy approaching. A sleeping heir does not know what belongs to him. But tonight, the spirit of God is sounding an alarm and I hear the Lord saying, "The season of your slumber is over." Let Let you something else. Go to Romans chapter 13 verse 11. Paul writing to the church in Rome says, "And that knowing the time that now it is high time to awake out of sleep, for now is our salvation nearer than when we believed." Listen carefully. Paul did not say it is time, he said it is high time. That phrase in the Greek carries a sense of urgency. It means the hour is late. It means you have already lost time. It means if you do not wake up now, you will miss what God has prepared for this season. And I want to tell you something, there are dimensions to this that the church has not fully understood. When God says arise, he's not just saying stand up physically. He's saying arise in your mentality. Arise in your faith. Arise in your prayer life. Arise in your expectations. Arise in your speech. Because the posture of your spirit determines what heaven can release into your life. You see, Psalm 24 verses 7 through 10 says, "Lift up your heads, oh ye gates, and be ye lifted up, ye everlasting doors. And the king of glory shall come in." Now, watch this. The gates had to lift up first. The doors had to open first before the king of glory could come in. Which means there are blessings that God has already dispatched from heaven, but they are waiting at the gate of your life. They are waiting for you to wake up. They are waiting for you to arise. They are waiting for your faith to lift the gate. And I don't know who I am talking to tonight, but the spirit of God is telling me to tell you, that business you have been praying about, the answer left heaven a long time ago. That healing you have been contending for, the angels of recovery were dispatched before you even started this prayer. That marriage breakthrough, the decree went forth from the throne before you open your mouth tonight, but heaven is waiting for you to take your position. Thus said the spirit of God, I have not forgotten you. I have not overlooked you. I have not passed you by, but I need you to arise because what I am about to do in your life requires your participation. Somebody shout, I am waking up. Now, listen. Let me go deeper because this is not a motivational speech. This is a prophetic instruction. And when you obey prophetic instruction, it activates dimensions of power that reasoning alone cannot access. In 2 Kings chapter 4, verses 1 through 7, you see the story of the widow whose husband and his son of the prophet had died, and the creditor was coming to take her two sons as slaves. She went to Elisha and cried out, and Elisha asked her, "What do you have in your house?" She said, "Nothing except a small jar of oil." And Elisha said, "Go, borrow vessels, not a few. Then shut the door and begin to pour." Now, here is what I need you to understand. The miracle was not in the oil alone. The miracle was in the instruction. When she obeyed the instruction, the oil that was small became more than enough. The oil that seemed insufficient became her deliverance, her debt cancellation, and her financial future. And I'm telling you tonight the reason many people have not experienced their breakthrough is not because God is unwilling. It is because they have not obeyed the instruction. God has given you something to do. He has given you a word to speak. He has given you a prayer to pray. He has given you an action to take, and you have been sitting on it waiting for the miracle to happen by itself. But miracles do not work that way. In the kingdom, obedience precedes manifestation. Faith is the currency, but obedience is the transaction. So, when God tells you to wake up and say this immediately, he's saying the moment you open your mouth and speak what I have put in your spirit, the wheels of heaven will begin to turn on your behalf. Ecclesiastes chapter 8 verse 4 says where the word of a king is, there is power. When a king speaks, things move. When a king decrees, armies mobilize. And I came to tell you tonight you are not just a Christian, you are not just a believer, you are royalty. 1 Peter chapter 2 verse 9 calls you a royal priesthood, and when royalty speaks, creation responds. The same God who said in Genesis chapter 1 verse 3, "Let there be light." And light appeared, that same God has breathed his spirit into you. And when you open your mouth in alignment with heaven, things that have been dead will come back to life. Doors that have been shut for years will open. Situations that seem permanent will shift in a moment. I decree and I declare over your life right now, every chain of spiritual slumber and break in the name of Jesus. Every spirit of heaviness, every spirit of delay, every spirit of stagnation that has sat upon your life like a blanket of darkness, I command it to lift right now by the fire of the Holy Ghost. Somebody say fire. You know the Bible says in Hebrews chapter 1 verse 7 that God makes his angels spirits and his ministers a flame of fire, which means when God sends a word, that word does not come empty. It comes wrapped in fire, and that fire is the force that destroys every resistance to your breakthrough. I want to show you something in the book of Ezekiel chapter 37 verses 1 through 10. God took Ezekiel to a valley, and the valley was full of dry bones. And God asked him, "Son of man, can these bones live?" And Ezekiel answered wisely. He said, "Lord, you know." And God said, "Prophesy to these bones. Say to them, 'O ye dry bones, hear the word of the Lord.'" And when Ezekiel prophesied, there was a noise. There was a shaking. Bone came together to bone. Sinew and flesh came upon them, but there was no breath. And God said, "Prophesy to the wind. Prophesy, son of man, and say to the wind, 'Come from the four winds, O breath, and breathe upon these slain, that they may live.'" Do you see the pattern? The breakthrough came through the prophetic word. The resurrection came through declaration. The life came because a man opened his mouth and spoke what God told him to speak. And I am here tonight as a mouthpiece of the Almighty. And I am speaking to every dead situation in your life. I am speaking to every dry bone. I am speaking to every area where life has left, where hope has left, where joy has left, where peace has left. And I am saying, "Hear the word of the Lord." Receive breath. Receive life. Receive resurrection power in the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth. That business that died, I speak life to it. That marriage that has been on the edge, I speak restoration. That health condition that the doctors have labeled terminal, I speak the healing virtue of Christ. That financial situation that has kept you in a cycle of lack, I speak abundance. I speak overflow. I speak more than enough. The Bible says in Joel chapter 2 verses 25 through 26, "And I will restore to you the years that the locust have eaten, the cankerworm and the caterpillar and the palmerworm, my great army which I sent among you. And you shall eat in plenty and be satisfied, and praise the name of the Lord your God that had dealt wondrously with you. Oh, I hear the spirit of God saying tonight, restoration is not coming. Restoration is here. You have been waiting for a future event, but God says the decree has already gone forth. From tonight, things begin to shift. From tonight, doors begin to open. From tonight, the hand of the almighty begins to rearrange your story. Somebody shout tonight. And see, this is what separates prophetic ministry from mere teaching. Teaching gives you understanding, [music] but prophecy releases power. Teaching tells you about the Red Sea, prophecy parts the Red Sea. Teaching tells you about the walls of Jericho, prophecy brings the walls down. And right now, we are not in a classroom, we are on the battlefield. And the weapons of our warfare are not carnal, but they are mighty through God to the pulling down of strongholds. Second Corinthians chapter 10 verse 4. So, I need you to rise up right now. Wherever you are, I need you on your feet. If you cannot stand, lift your hands, but take a posture of war because we are about to enter into a dimension of prayer that will dismantle everything the enemy has built against your destiny. Are you ready? Father, in the name of Jesus, I come before your throne right now. Not as a man, but as a vessel carrying the authority of the risen Christ. And I stand in the gap for every soul connected to this word tonight. >> [music] >> Every man, every woman, every young person, every child, I cover them with the blood of Jesus. I plead the blood over their lives, over their families, over their destinies, over their finances, over their health, over their minds, over their marriages, over their children, over their businesses, over their ministries, and I declare no weapon formed against them shall prosper. Every tongue that rises against them in judgment, I condemn right now. For this is the heritage of the servants of the Lord. Isaiah chapter 54:17. Now, hear me. I want to pray with precision because the spirit of God is giving me specific targets tonight and I need your faith to connect with these prayers. Don't just listen. Agree. Say amen with violence. Say it like your breakthrough depends on it because it does. The first thing I want to address is destiny. Your destiny, the calling of God upon your life, the reason you were born, the purpose for which heaven invested in you. Listen to me. There are people whose destinies have been caged. The enemy using covenants that were made by their ancestors, using altars that were erected before they were born, using words that were spoken over their bloodline, the enemy has placed a cage around their destiny. And that is why no matter what they do, no matter how hard they try, they keep hitting a ceiling. They keep going in circles. They keep experiencing near success syndrome where they almost get it but at the last minute, it slips away. But I hear the Lord saying tonight, the cage breaks. In the name of Jesus Christ, I speak to every cage over your destiny, shatter. I speak to every invisible chain holding your purpose hostage, break by fire. Every covenant made at any altar, whether it was made by your father, your mother, your grandfather, your grandmother, or anyone in your bloodline, I revoke it tonight. I cancel IT TONIGHT. EVERY CANCEL it tonight. I nullify it by the blood of the lamb. The Bible says in Colossians chapter 2:14-15 that Jesus blotted out the handwriting of ordinances that was against us, which was contrary to us, and took it out of the way, nailing it to his cross. And having spoiled principalities and powers, he made a show of them openly, triumphing over them in it. So, I declare every ordinance written against your life, I blot it out tonight. Every legal document in the courts of darkness that the enemy has been using to enforce delay, to enforce failure, to enforce sickness, to enforce poverty, I tear it up by the blood of Jesus. I set it on fire by the Holy Ghost, and I declare the case is closed. The verdict is in your favor. The judge of all the earth has ruled, and he has ruled in your favor. Now, I move to your family, because the enemy does not just attack individuals. He attacks bloodlines, he attacks families, he attacks generations, and there are families tonight where there is a pattern, a pattern of divorce, a pattern of premature death, a pattern of mental illness, a pattern of poverty, a pattern of failure at the edge of breakthrough. But, thus saith the Lord, the pattern ends tonight. Ezekiel chapter 18 verse 3 says, "As I live, saith the Lord God, you shall not have occasion anymore to use this proverb in Israel." God is saying the proverb that has been spoken over your family, the narrative that has followed your surname, the story that people tell when they hear your family name, that narrative is changing tonight. I decree every generational curse operating in your family line, I break it now. Every spirit of untimely death, I bind you, and I cast you out. Every spirit of marital failure that has been recycling in your bloodline, I uproot you from the foundation. Every spirit of poverty and financial struggle that has become a family identity, I silence you permanently by the authority of the name of Jesus. Father, let the blood of Jesus speak over this family tonight. Let the blood that is better than the blood of Abel cry out over their lineage and rewrite their story. Let a new chapter begin. Let a new generation arise that will know prosperity, that will know peace, that will know longevity, that will know the favor of the almighty. In Jesus name. Bakasha latairo busende shamakala batairo bashende koloshama baratoshende Yes, Lord. Yes, Lord. Now, somebody here tonight, I'm sensing this very strongly. There is a woman and you have been believing God for the fruit of the womb. And the doctors have said things and family members have said things and the years have been passing and every time you see another woman carrying a baby, something breaks inside of you. And you smile on the outside, but you are weeping on the inside. Hear the word of the Lord. First Samuel chapter 1 verse 19 says, "And the Lord remembered her. The Lord remembered Hannah." And I prophesy to you tonight, the Lord is remembering you right now. Right now, as this word is going forth, the almighty is visiting your womb. He's opening what has been shut. He's loosening what has been bound. And I decree within the time of life, you shall embrace a son, you shall embrace a daughter. The barrenness is over, the reproach is lifted, the waiting is finished. Receive it in the name of Jesus. And there is a man, your name is connected to the name David or it sounds like David or your middle name carries that sound. And the Lord is telling me to tell you that business contract that fell through in the last quarter, it is coming back, but it is not coming back the same. It is coming back multiplied. What the enemy stole, God is restoring sevenfold. Proverbs chapter 6:31 says, "When the thief is found, he shall restore sevenfold." And I declare the thief has been found tonight, and restitution is being enforced from the courts of heaven. Now, I want to deal with the area of finances because I know there are people connected to this service tonight, and the financial pressure has been so severe that it has affected your sleep, it has affected your prayer life, it has affected your faith, it has affected your relationships. But I want you to hear what the word says. Philippians chapter 4:19 says, "But my God shall supply all your need according to his riches in glory by Christ Jesus." Not according to the economy, not according to your salary, not according to the exchange rate, according to his riches in glory. And his riches have no limit, his resources have no boundary, his treasury never runs dry. So I open the gates of financial provision over your life. Tonight, I decree every gate of supply that has been shut against you, open now in the name of Jesus. Every financial embargo placed upon your life by the powers of darkness, I break [music] it now. Every spirit of financial wastage, where money comes in but has no impact, where money comes but disappears before you can account for it, I rebuke that spirit right now, and I command it to lose its hold over your finances. I speak to the north, I speak to the south, I speak to the east, I speak to the west. Release the provision that belongs to this child of God. Angels of provision, angels of connection, angels of financial breakthrough, I charge you in the name of Jesus. Go forth tonight and begin to arrange financial miracles, divine connections, business opportunities, job offers, contracts, grants, inheritances, and unexpected streams of income. Deuteronomy chapter 8 verse 18 says, "But thou shall remember the Lord thy God, for it is he that giveth thee power to get wealth." And I declare that power is activated in your life tonight. You will not beg, you will not borrow in shame, you will not live from hand to mouth, you will lend to nations. You will finance the gospel, you will build and inhabit, you will plant and eat the fruit thereof. In the name of Jesus. Shakara bavente, kolosha mente rashende, bavara shantikole. I feel the fire of God in this place. I feel the fire. And now I speak to someone concerning health. There is someone watching this right now and you have been battling a condition in your body. It may be in your blood, it may be in your chest. It may be in your bones, it may be in your reproductive system. And you have been to the hospital, you have done the tests, and the reports have not been favorable. But I want you to hear this. Psalm 107 verse 20 says, "He sent his word and healed them and delivered them from their destructions." God heals with his word. And tonight, this word is your medicine. This word is your therapy. This word is your surgical procedure from heaven. I command every infirmity to leave your body now in the name of Jesus. Cancer, get out. Fibroid, shrink and dissolve. Diabetes, I command your blood sugar to normalize by the power of the Holy Ghost. High blood pressure, I speak peace to your cardiovascular system. Migraine, lose your hold. Kidney failure, I command those organs to function in the name that is above every name. Hormonal imbalance, I speak the balancing power of the spirit of God. You are healed. Not because I say so, but because Isaiah chapter 53 verse 5 says by his stripes you were healed. Not you will be healed, you were healed. It is already done. It was finished on the cross. And tonight, you are simply collecting what has already been paid for. Receive your healing now. Receive your healing now. In the name of Jesus. And I move now to the area of marriage. There are people tonight and your marriage is in crisis, the love has grown cold, communication has broken down. There is suspicion, there is bitterness, there is anger, there is unforgiveness. And the enemy is whispering it is over, there is no point trying. But I rebuke that lying spirit right now. Malachi chapter 2 verse 16 says God hates divorce. And what God hates, he fights against. And I am telling you God is fighting for your marriage tonight. I speak the fire of God into every marriage under the sound of my voice. I command every spirit of division, every spirit of misunderstanding, every spirit of lust that has introduced a third party, I command you to leave that marriage right now. Every strange woman, every strange man, every person who has been planted by the enemy to destroy that union, I decree a supernatural separation right now.
